title: 空色の境界線、きみの温度
author: 小春 ことり

en.title: Sky‑Blue Boundary, Your Temperature
en.premise: I have always kept my distance from everyone, living a quiet, solitary life. Then I meet Haru, a boy who keeps changing schools. Like a migratory bird, he is destined to leave this town someday. In the desert of loneliness, the time spent with him feels like the only oasis—comforting yet terrifying the thought of an ending. A quiet romance and an inevitable farewell.

zh.title: 天空蓝色的边界线，你的温度
zh.premise: 我一直过着与人保持距离的生活，直到遇见了不断转校的少年哈鲁。他像候鸟一样，注定有一天会离开这座城市。在孤独的沙漠中，和他相处的时光像唯一的绿洲，既舒适又让人害怕结束的到来。静静的恋爱与不可避免的别离的故事。
